description: Writable reactive value. Read with `s()`, write with `s.set(v)` or `s.update(fn)`.
Read-only signal derived from others. Lazy, memoized, tracks dependencies dynamically.
Runs a side effect whenever the signals it read change. Created in an injection context, destroyed with its owner, runs asynchronously.
Signals notify only when the new value is not `Object.is`-equal to the old one. Customize with `{ equal }`.
Exposes a writable signal as a read-only `Signal<T>`, e.g. from a service.
Replace arrays/objects (`[...list, x]`, `{ ...obj, a: 1 }`) so the signal sees a new reference.
